test_title: PYST 56: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, B, C, D, T, U, V and W, are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only two people sit between V and D. Only U sits to the right of T. Only one person sits between D and T. C sits at some place to the right of B but at some place to the left of W. How many people sit between W and B?
solution:
Given:

→ Seven friends B, C, D, T, U, V and W are sitting in a str
aight line facing north.

→ Only two people sit between V and D.

→ Only U sits to the right of T.

→ Only one person sits between D and T.

→ C sits to the right of B but to the left of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85703081e36b6a5832802526e1d253bf57a1924098765f2c7ba752813e7aecbb.png] B is at position 2.

W is at position 5.

People between them = C and D = 2 people

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4 - Two".
